items.title: Reposting a single comment is now possible.
items.para: Funny or useful replies can earn reach on their own, outside the original thread.
items.tip: Community management becomes a growth lever. Keep fast, on-brand replies and tight moderation.

items.title: A home screen that opens on Reels is in test.
items.para: Reels fill the first tab, Stories sit above them and sound plays by default.
items.tip: Plan vertical video versions of lineups and final scores, with strong first seconds.

items.title: Mosseri on ranking: 4 signals.
items.para: Interaction rates, timing, originality and testing with non-followers.
items.tip: Judge posts by engagement rate, favour original footage and test with Trial Reels.

items.title: Your Algorithm lets fans choose topics.
items.para: Users add topics, say why they liked a post and describe what they want to see more or less of.
items.tip: Tie posts to topics fans would pick: team, competition, players. Use clear captions and content pillars.

items.title: Meta One bundles AI tools with app perks.
items.para: New plans for businesses, creators and heavy AI users, from $2.99 to $499 a month.
items.tip: Trial a low tier on one account, such as an academy channel, before scaling.
